# bluestonepim_attribute_group_definition_order (Resource)

The manual order of the attribute definitions in an attribute group. The group must have `order_by_name = false`. The listed definitions are placed first, in the given order; definitions that are not listed keep their relative order after them. Removing the resource leaves the order as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group" "dimensions" {
  name          = "Dimensions"
  order_by_name = false
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_definition" "width" {
  name      = "Width"
  data_type = "decimal"
  group_id  = bluestonepim_attribute_group.dimensions.id
}

resource "bluestonepim_attribute_definition" "height" {
  name      = "Height"
  data_type = "decimal"
  group_id  = bluestonepim_attribute_group.dimensions.id
}

# Definitions in the group that are not listed here are shown after these
resource "bluestonepim_attribute_group_definition_order" "dimensions" {
  group_id = bluestonepim_attribute_group.dimensions.id
  definition_ids = [
    bluestonepim_attribute_definition.height.id,
    bluestonepim_attribute_definition.width.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition_ids` (List of String) The IDs of the attribute definitions in the group, in the order they should be shown. The definitions must belong to the group (see `group_id` on the definitions).
- `group_id` (String) The ID of the attribute group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bluestonepim_attribute_group_definition_order.dimensions <group_id>
```
